result.brief: 提出免训练的粒子滤波奖励引导框架，通过全局-局部细化实现精确一致的相机轨迹控制视频生成，并可用于生成相机条件训练数据。
result.reason: Training-free particle-filter reward guidance for camera-controlled video diffusion, improving trajectory adherence and drift; directly serves controllable video generation and camera-conditioned data for world modeling.
